scripts.// start: Interactive setup: choose where to copy and sync skills (global ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude/skills, or sibling repositories).
scripts.// claude: Installs the plugin from this local checkout into Claude Code: registers the marketplace, refreshes it, then installs or updates jookoi-dev@jookoi-ai-market. Bump plugin.json version first.
scripts.claude: claude plugin marketplace add ./ && claude plugin marketplace update jookoi-ai-market && claude plugin install jookoi-dev@jookoi-ai-market && claude plugin update jookoi-dev@jookoi-ai-market
scripts.// sync: Copies the latest skills from plugins/*/skills/ into folders listed in SKILL_TARGETS (.env). Run after pulling or editing a skill.
scripts.// sync:force: Overwrites target copies even when they are newer than this repo.
scripts.// update-skills: Validates plugin manifests, checks SKILL.md metadata, and re-audits cross-references.
